description.value: 49th Parallel is a Vancouver-based specialty coffee roaster with a cafe on the eclectic Main Street corridor, co-located with Lucky's Doughnuts for fresh-made pastries throughout the day. The cafe is part of a small multi-location group with outposts across Vancouver and Montreal. Cyclists riding the Main Street bike route will find it a convenient stop for quality espresso and a doughnut.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at 49thcafe.com is live and confirms the Main St location (2902 Main St, Vancouver), and states 'ALL CAFES ARE NOW OPEN 7 DAYS A WEEK', confirming the business is open. The website presents the business under the name '49th Cafe & Lucky's Doughnuts' and the footer reads '49th Parallel Café & Lucky's Doughnuts', which differs from the OSM name '49th Parallel Coffee Roasters' — this is flagged as a concern. Takeout is confirmed by OSM takeaway=yes and the website's 'Order Now' functionality; a gluten-free option is explicitly mentioned on the website homepage.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM lists '49th Parallel Coffee Roasters' but the website header reads '49th Cafe & Lucky's Doughnuts' and the footer reads '49th Parallel Café & Lucky's Doughnuts'. The business appears to have rebranded or the OSM name is outdated.
Phone number (+1 604-872-4901) was not visible in the fetched website content and could not be confirmed from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, confirmed-open cafe on a key Vancouver cycling corridor. Straightforward include.
